contents.text: What was Netflix's net cash provided by operating activities, sum up the numbers?

The net cash provided by operating activities for the years 2025, 2024, and 2023 were $10,149,273, $7,361,364, and $7,274,301, respectively. 

$10,149,273 + $7,361,364 + $7,274,301 = $24,785,038 (in thousands) for the years 2025, 2024, and 2023. 

(Source: NFLX-10K-2025.html, PART IV > Financial Statements > CONSOLIDATED STATEMENTS OF CASH FLOWS > Changes in operating assets and liabilities)
